Quite at first then a good few more people arrived, meeting people from different background was a very enjoyable time.
The lovely young lady who is getting the coffee morning started ‘Sanah’ is a very nicely spoken lady and very welcoming with a lovely smile, another young lady at shanti medical centre joined the coffee morning ‘Jo Jo’ a very lovely lady with a big welcoming lovely smile.

My father received a phone call the previous day from someone at the surgery to say he needed to attend an appointment the following day. I took time off work to accompany him to his appointment. When we arrived at the surgery I mentioned to the receptionist my dad had an appointment to which she replied "there's no appointment booked for him and nothing was noted and on the system either". My dad was insistent that he had received a call from them even though she was denying any phone call being made by the surgery. My father remembered that the call was made to his mobile phone so the incoming call must have been saved on his call history, so when we presented her with the evidence that a call had been made to my dad from the surgery and here was the proof, she became very defensive and immediately started to back track on what she had said to me 30 seconds previously. The thing that annoyed me the most was that instead of admitting her fault and saying I'm sorry I can see a phone call was made by someone from the surgery, let me see why it's not been logged and we'll try to resolve this situation, instead she lied about what she had just said to me and she was trying to shift the blame on to me, with a condescending tone she said "its not my fault you didn't understand what I said" insinuating that I was not bright enough to understand what she was saying to me, which was not only rude but also insulting to the say the least.  I refused to talk to her any longer and asked to speak to somebody else who was competent and honest. Another receptionist stepped in and dealt with the issue.
